items.title: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4 weights for self-hosting
problems: The item says teams could call the model through hosted services during preview, but neither source says preview access included hosted inference.
notes: The sources do not state a release day; the announcement says weights are released “today” and describes a public preview earlier that month.
